name: commit-plan
description: Create an approval-ready commit plan with the planning-git-commits skill, without staging or committing.
template:
Create a commit plan. Load the `planning-git-commits` skill and follow it through step 3 (Present Plan). Plan only: never stage, commit, or push.

{{#if scope}}Plan these files: {{scope}}
{{else}}Plan the files from the working tree: run `git status --porcelain`.
{{/if}}

1. Run the skill's step 0 checks before planning.
2. Group the files into logical conventional commits using the skill's scope rules. Keep subjects imperative and at most 72 characters; mark breaking changes with `!`.
3. Present the plan in the skill's format: one `### Commit N: <type>(<scope>): <message>` heading followed by its `**Files:**` list.
4. Ask for approval. Revise on request; do not run `git add`, `git commit`, or `git push`.

Stop after approval and hand the plan to the `commit` prompt. Reply with the plan only.

variables.name: scope
variables.label: Scope
variables.description: Files to plan. Leave blank to derive them from the working tree.
